name: md2ui
description: md2ui shows Claude's answers as UI in a native window and returns your clicks, with the authoring tools to check and preview them.

theme.title: THEME.md
theme.description: Your theme. Leave empty for a THEME.md in the project's folder, else md2ui's default theme.

working_line.title: Working line
working_line.description: While Claude works, the window says what it is doing: a Bash call's description, else the tool and a file's name, never a command or a path. Turn off to show only the working animation.
